title: Make cold-start not-ready responses guide agents to retry Phoenix
outcome: Transient index-building and refresh-sweep readiness responses keep agents on Phoenix with executable retry guidance instead of recommending shell fallback.
acceptance: A product test at the CLI boundary parks the sweep and asserts exit 1 plus the exact retry fields.
Not-ready index_unavailable/index_building envelopes set retryRecommended true and tell agents to poll server_capabilities until index.state is ready before repeating the same call.
The transient readiness hint no longer recommends shell search.

completion.summary: Delivered cold-start not-ready guidance that keeps agents on Phoenix with an executable retry contract.
